title: NightItems
description: AI service -> game (GET /night/items?since=<seq>, B7 R10, D637): what the job queue has to do tonight and what got done, for the dream scene (B2579). One item per job and state change, numbered from 1 and never reused within a service session; a since larger than the newest number means the service restarted and gives the items from the start. The service invents nothing: inhabitant and object_type come unchanged from the core's job. No wording of questions, dreams or memories (like the question window, B6 R12). Kept only for the current night and only in memory, like the queue (R4).

phase.description: The phase the service is in now.

items.description: Items with a number greater than since, oldest first.

inhabitant.description: Inhabitant the job is about, as the core sent it; null if none.

object_type.description: Object type the job is about (the object_type of the job's payload, as the core sent it); null if the job names none.

image.description: File name of a picture the job made (image result, the service's output folder, no path); only for a done image job, null otherwise.
